faq_heading: New construction in Vancouver Heights, Burnaby: your questions answered

faq.q: What have houses in Vancouver Heights, Burnaby sold for?
faq.a: 19 houses sold in Vancouver Heights, Burnaby at a median of $2,075,000, with the middle half between $1,665,000 and $2,221,500.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Vancouver Heights, Burnaby?
faq.a: In Vancouver Heights, Burnaby, houses were quickest at 21 days at a median, and condos slowest at 26 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Vancouver Heights, Burnaby are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Vancouver Heights, Burnaby, condos had the newest median build year, 2006.

items.t: In Vancouver Heights, Burnaby, houses sold at a median of $2,075,000 across 19 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,665,000 and $2,221,500. The median house sat 21 days and sold for 97.1% of list.
Vancouver Heights, Burnaby: 15 condos sold at a median of $565,000, with the middle half between $491,500 and $976,900. The median condo took 26 days to sell and closed at 95.9% of list.

blocks.text: 3 Duplexes also sold in Vancouver Heights, Burnaby, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Vancouver Heights compares with the rest of Burnaby North

items.t: Of 11 Burnaby North sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Vancouver Heights ranks second highest at $2,075,000; the range is $1,650,000 (Central BN) to $2,380,000 (Government Road). Capitol Hill BN ($2,040,000) sits just below and Government Road ($2,380,000) sits just above.

Condos in Vancouver Heights have the 5th highest median of 8 Burnaby North sub-areas, $565,000. Cariboo is lowest at $440,900 and Brentwood Park highest at $693,750. Simon Fraser Univer. ($512,000) sits just below and Sullivan Heights ($567,500) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Vancouver Heights, Burnaby (median 2006) and houses the oldest (median 1978), a gap of 28 years.
No single Vancouver Heights, Burnaby condo building or townhome complex had 3 or more resales over the past year.
